name: Chenae Carey
reason: Not a spiritual teacher in practice: her own site (chenaecarey.com, home, about and work-with-me pages) presents her as an intuitive business mentor for women-run businesses; every offering (private mentoring, The Expansion Circle, Bold Leaps, lead-management workshops, an Insight Timer earnings course) is business-growth coaching with some 'energetic alignment' framing. A contact route exists (chenae@chenaecarey.com, mailto on /contact/; base Cairns, Queensland), so the owner may list her as life-coaching if wanted.
